Aldorei's Secret Part II#131.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.src: All I can say is that I am old enough.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.dst: Скажу лишь, что я достаточно стара.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#132.speaker: Mona

Aldorei's Secret Part II#134.src: Worry not, the great Amber is here to help you find your way!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#134.dst: Не бойся, великая Amber поможет тебе найти дорогу!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#134.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#137.src: My name is Amber of the Sol Embassy Royal Task Force!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#137.dst: Меня зовут Amber, я из королевского спецотряда посольства Sol!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#137.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#138.src: It is my duty to protect the city from wrongdoers!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#138.dst: Мой долг - защищать город от злодеев!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#138.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#139.src: You AREN'T A THIEF ARE YOU? OR A ROBBER? OR MURDERER!? ARSONIST!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#139.dst: Ты ведь НЕ ВОР? НЕ ГРАБИТЕЛЬ? НЕ УБИЙЦА!? НЕ ПОДЖИГАТЕЛЬ!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#139.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#140.src: I let my imagination get the best of me!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#140.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#141.src: My main job is patrolling the grounds and making sure no one is doing anything they shouldn't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#141.dst: Моя главная работа - патрулировать округу и следить, чтобы никто не делал ничего запретного.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#141.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#142.src: Maybe I shouldn't have said all of that...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#142.dst: Наверное, зря я всё это сказала…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#142.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#143.src: Can I help you with anything else?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#143.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#146.src: I report who comes and leaves the town. Who sells what. Who buys what. Who talks with who.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#146.dst: Кто входит в город и уходит. Кто что продаёт. Кто что покупает. Кто с кем говорит.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#146.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#147.src: The list goes on and on and on and on and on... and on... and on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#147.dst: Список всё длится, и длится, и длится, и длится… и длится… и длится.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#147.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#148.src: They like keeping track of what happens inside the town!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#148.dst: Им нравится знать всё, что творится в городе!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#148.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#150.src: The Sol Embassy and its elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#150.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#152.src: Enjoy this wonderful town. Don't hesitate to ask me for help!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#152.dst: Наслаждайся этим чудесным городом. Обращайся за помощью!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#152.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#157.src: I... I... No! Bullies don't affect me... *sniffles*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#157.dst: Я… я… Нет! Задиры на меня не действуют… *всхлип*
Aldorei's Secret Part II#157.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#158.src: Oh it's you. I can't believe we let a human into this place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#158.dst: А, это ты. Не верится, что сюда пустили человека.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#158.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#161.src: You dare speak to me like that?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#161.dst: Ты смеешь так со мной говорить?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#161.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#162.src: I will get you deported if it's the last thing I do, mark my words!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#162.dst: Я добьюсь твоей высылки, даже если это будет последнее, что я сделаю!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#162.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#163.src: So what is it you need?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#163.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#166.src: If you don't mind me asking... Is your friend from {p}?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#166.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#168.src: Farewell. Make sure to let everyone know I'm the smartest!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#168.dst: Прощай. И скажи всем, что я самый умный!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#168.speaker: Sol

Aldorei's Secret Part II#173.src: You humans are really stupid I have to say... zzz......
Aldorei's Secret Part II#173.dst: Скажу честно, вы, люди, ужасно глупы… хррр……
Aldorei's Secret Part II#173.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#175.src: I'm younger than most here, you see. I'm just about a hundred years old.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#175.dst: Видишь ли, я моложе многих здесь. Мне всего около ста лет.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#175.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#176.dst: Много ли таких, как ты, по возрасту?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.src: No. Do you not know of the child regulations here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.dst: Нет. Ты не знаешь здешних правил о детях?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#177.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.src: There are very strict restrictions on who or when someone can have children here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.dst: Здесь очень строго решают, кому и когда можно заводить детей.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#178.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#179.src: The main reason elves have moved to {p}, to start families.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#179.dst: Главная причина, почему эльфы уходят в {p}, - чтобы завести семью.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#179.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#181.src: I can't really say... You really don't want to break the rules here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#181.dst: Не могу сказать… Правила здесь лучше не нарушать.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#181.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#182.src: I can give you some information but you need to leave me alone after.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#182.dst: Кое-что расскажу, но потом оставь меня в покое.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#182.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#185.src: I'm not that much for... image and status.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#185.dst: Меня не особо волнуют… образ и статус.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#185.speaker: Mané

Aldorei's Secret Part II#186.src: Return to Olon with the information at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#186.dst: Вернись к Olon со сведениями в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#190.src: Good idea! I overheard some elves talking about an underground river running under the town.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#190.dst: Хорошая мысль! Я подслушал, как эльфы говорили о подземной реке под городом.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#190.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#191.src: So if you find water, you find the river.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#191.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#192.src: I'll keep my distance, don't want to draw too much attention.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#192.dst: Я буду держаться поодаль, не хочу привлекать внимание.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#192.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#194.src: I don't know how that will solve anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#194.dst: Не понимаю, как это что-то решит.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#194.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#195.src: I mean, you talked to the citizens so maybe you know something I don't.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#195.dst: Но жителей расспрашивать довелось тебе, может, ты знаешь больше.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#195.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#196.src: Sure. Let's meet up at the potion merchant then.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#196.dst: Ладно. Тогда встретимся у торговца зельями.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#196.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#198.src: Amber here! Ready to catch the bad guys!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#198.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#199.src: Are you here to report something?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#199.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#200.src: Hold on! Why are you with an {p} elf? Is this some sort of spy mission to take over {p} and turn it into a capitalistic society?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#200.dst: Стоп! Почему ты с эльфом из {p}? Это шпионская миссия, чтобы захватить {p} и превратить его в капиталистическое общество?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#200.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#201.src: I will have to report this to the elders immediately!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#201.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#203.src: Please don't Amber! We are f
Aldorei's Secret Part II#203.dst: Пожалуйста, не надо, Amber! Мы же друзья?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#204.src: I am a respected member of the task force. My only friend is the law.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#204.dst: Я уважаемый член спецотряда. Мой единственный друг - закон.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#204.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#206.src: I'm not sure what the punishment for talking to an {p} elf is but I would imagine at least hanging and dawn. Or is there even a punishment?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#206.dst: Не знаю, как карают за разговор с эльфом из {p}, но, наверное, как минимум виселица на рассвете. Или наказания вообще нет?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#206.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#207.src: Let's just get out of here. I saw looking into the underground river would have been the smartest move in the first place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#207.dst: Давай просто уйдём отсюда. Я же говорил, что умнее всего было сразу проверить подземную реку.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#207.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#208.src: But money... I could go shopping in {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#208.dst: Но деньги… Я могла бы пройтись по магазинам в {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#208.speaker: Amber

Aldorei's Secret Part II#210.src: Alright time to listen to me now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#210.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#211.src: Find the underground area of {p} near the waterfall.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#212.src: Let's hope no elves are following us down here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#212.dst: Надеюсь, никто из эльфов не спустился за нами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#212.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#214.src: Let's look for objects that resemble the {p} style down here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#214.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#215.src: So yeah, let's hope we didn't draw any unneeded attention by doing all that unnecessary stuff.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#215.dst: В общем, надеюсь, всей этой лишней суетой мы не привлекли ненужного внимания.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#215.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#218.src: What exactly are we doing here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#218.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#220.src: Why didn't you just say that. Here, it's on me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#220.dst: Так бы сразу и сказал. Держи, я угощаю.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#220.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#223.src: Can we get back on track now?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#223.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#224.src: I overheard some elves talking about an underground river running under the town. So if you find water, you find the river.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#224.dst: Я подслушал, как эльфы говорили о подземной реке под городом. Найдёшь воду - найдёшь реку.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#224.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#228.src: This looks suspicious enough to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#228.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#229.src: Let me see if I can get us through.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#229.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#232.src: Cast a spell on the boulders with Olon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#232.dst: Сотвори заклинание на валуны вместе с Olon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#236.src: Did you just... dig up a grave?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#236.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#237.src: This is an important piece of HISTORY.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#237.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#238.src: I will look away and pretend I didn't see that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#238.dst: Я отвернусь и сделаю вид, что ничего не видел.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#238.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#239.src: Investigate the graves in the tomb.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#240.src: {~}BP - {~}BP (before portal)He will welcome you with open arms, your devotion to knowledge was unmatched.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#240.dst: {~}BP - {~}BP (до портала)Он примет тебя с объятиями: в преданности знанию тебе не было равных.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#240.speaker: Natt Moonchaser

Aldorei's Secret Part II#241.src: {~}BP - {~}BP (before portal)To reunite with her lost sister. May the light bring her this gift for her devotion.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#241.dst: {~}BP - {~}BP (до портала)Воссоединиться с потерянной сестрой. Да дарует ей Свет это за её преданность.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#241.speaker: Dew Riverbreeze

Aldorei's Secret Part II#242.src: {~}BP - {~}BP (before portal)Will forever be remembered for his poetry and texts. May you be reunited with the light.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#242.dst: {~}BP - {~}BP (до портала)Его стихи и труды будут помнить вечно. Да воссоединишься ты со Светом.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#242.speaker: Moln Cloudcatcher

Aldorei's Secret Part II#243.src: I assume you found the same stuff I did.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#243.dst: У тебя, наверное, те же находки.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#243.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#245.src: {~} years ago... Could this be connected to the portal over in the Wynn province?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#245.dst: {~} лет назад… Может, это связано с порталом в провинции Wynn?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#245.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#247.src: Did the elves of {p} actually grasp the light?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#247.dst: Неужели эльфы {p} и правда постигли Свет?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#247.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#250.src: And meet him. The God of Light, Orphion.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#250.dst: И встречает Его - бога Света Orphion.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#250.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#252.src: I think it's time we pay the elders a visit.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#252.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#253.src: They have some explaining to do.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#253.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#254.dst: Именно об этом я и думал.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#254.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#255.src: I wonder why some graves are
Aldorei's Secret Part II#255.dst: Интересно, почему некоторые могилы сохранились лучше.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#256.src: It's sad to say, but it's true.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#256.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#257.src: People who are knowledgable, magically gifted or well versed in the arts are seen as better.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#257.dst: Тех, кто учён, одарён в магии или сведущ в искусствах, считают выше других.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#257.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#258.src: I would assume the majority got the lesser ones...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#258.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#260.src: I'll make sure {p} NEVER becomes like this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#260.dst: Я прослежу, чтобы {p} НИКОГДА таким не стал.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#260.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#262.src: They should be at the top of this building. Follow the golden carpet to get there!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#262.dst: Они должны быть на верхнем этаже этого здания. Иди по золотому ковру!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#262.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#264.src: We need to watch out for the guards.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#264.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#266.src: This is our chance to run past!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#266.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#269.src: We know your dark secrets and we have proof!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#269.dst: Мы знаем ваши тёмные тайны, и у нас есть доказательства!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#269.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#270.src: What nonsense, who let this ginger rat in here!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#270.dst: Что за чушь, кто впустил сюда эту рыжую крысу!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#270.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#271.src: Who are you calling a rat!? Pulling the ginger card too!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#271.dst: Кого это вы назвали крысой!? Ещё и рыжим попрекаете!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#271.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#272.src: Can somebody please get the Sol Embassy Guards for us?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#272.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#273.src: Wait a second... human, what are you doing here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#273.dst: Минуточку… человек, что ты здесь делаешь?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#273.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#274.src: Erm- I must've taken a wrong
Aldorei's Secret Part II#274.dst: Э-э… кажется, это не та дорога.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#276.src: We saw you arrive with this elf, us elders aren't that gullible.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#276.dst: Мы видели тебя с этим эльфом. Нас, старейшин, так просто не провести.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#276.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#277.src: ... I really thought you'd have my back out there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#277.dst: … А я-то думал, ты меня прикроешь.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#277.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#278.src: What are you REALLY doing here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#278.dst: Что ты здесь НА САМОМ ДЕЛЕ делаешь?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#278.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#280.src: So you admit that your invitation to {p} is being used to threaten us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#280.dst: Значит, ты признаёшь, что приглашение в {p} нужно, чтобы угрожать нам.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#280.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#281.src: I knew letting foreigners into our town would come back to bite us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#281.dst: Я знал, что пускать чужаков в город выйдет нам боком.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#281.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#282.src: Guards- arrest these pests and get them to the dungeons!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#282.dst: Стража, схватить этих паразитов и в темницу!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#282.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#285.src: And you admit you're a part of this elf's posse?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#285.dst: И ты признаёшь, что заодно с этим эльфом?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#285.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#286.src: Guards- arrest these pests and get them to the dungeons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#286.dst: Стража, схватить этих паразитов и в темницу.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#286.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#288.src: You said you had proof of something, tell me- what have you found?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#288.dst: Вы говорили о доказательствах. Скажите - что вы нашли?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#288.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#290.src: We found the old cemetery under the city and aren't afraid to expose you to the world!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#290.dst: Мы нашли старое кладбище под городом и не побоимся раскрыть вас всему миру!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#290.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#291.src: My parents both suffered and I only have you to blame for it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#291.dst: Мои родители страдали, и винить в этом я могу только вас.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#291.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#293.src: That's enough! To the dungeons with you now!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#293.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#294.src: This is looking bad, you need to say something!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#294.dst: Дело плохо, тебе надо что-то сказать!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#295.src: I'm sure you must realize by now we are the elders for a reason?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#295.dst: Надеюсь, вы уже поняли, что старейшинами мы стали не просто так?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#295.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#296.src: Us elves are ten times more powerful than any human by nature.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#296.dst: Мы, эльфы, от природы вдесятеро сильнее любого человека.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#296.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#297.src: Just because we tend to solve things peacefully doesn't mean we can't use brute force.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#297.dst: То, что мы решаем дела миром, не значит, что мы не можем применить силу.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#297.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.src: No! {u}, I am not letting this go! I will get justice for my parents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.dst: Нет! {u}, я так этого не оставлю! Родители будут отомщены.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#298.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#299.src: How come one of the pedestal

Aldorei's Secret Part II#300.src: Pfft- it's merely a design flaw.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#300.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.src: Don't try to trick us with your mind games.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.dst: Не пытайтесь провести нас своими играми разума.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#301.speaker: Elder Willow

Aldorei's Secret Part II#302.src: Just let us go, your secret
Aldorei's Secret Part II#302.dst: Отпустите нас, ваш секрет останется с нами.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#305.src: Escape the town hall with Olon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#305.dst: Сбеги из ратуши вместе с Olon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#309.src: You know... I didn't really think that would work, and I was right.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#309.dst: Знаешь… я и не думал, что это сработает, и оказался прав.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#309.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#310.src: But I think I figured it out...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#310.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#311.dst: Один из эльфов упоминал, что старейшин {~}.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#312.src: Exactly! You've got a keen eye for this kinda thing.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#312.dst: Именно! У тебя намётанный глаз на такие вещи.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#312.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#313.src: The question is if she lied, or if something else happened.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#313.dst: Вопрос в том, солгала ли она или случилось что-то ещё.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#313.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#314.src: One of the seats were empty but most importantly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#314.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#315.src: I glanced over at the shelves behind them and saw papers signed by another name.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#315.dst: Я глянул на полки за ними и увидел бумаги, подписанные другим именем.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#315.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.src: So the question is... what happened to them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.dst: Так вопрос в том… что с ним стало?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#316.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#318.src: No- but I noticed something that didn't add up with our previous information.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#318.dst: Нет, но я заметил то, что не сходится с прежними сведениями.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#318.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#319.src: One of the seats were empty and one of the elves mentioned six elders, did she not?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#319.dst: Одно место пустовало, а одна эльфийка упоминала шесть старейшин, так ведь?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#319.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#320.src: I'm guessing the Elders got into a big disagreement and decided to rid of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#320.dst: Думаю, старейшины крупно разругались и решили от него избавиться.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#320.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#321.src: So I doubt they have any records of that occurring here...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#321.dst: Так что вряд ли здесь есть записи об этом…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#321.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#322.src: That seemed to put Birch in a bad mood. You need to try again!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#322.dst: Похоже, Birch от этого помрачнел. Попробуй ещё раз!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#323.src: He told us where to find you
Aldorei's Secret Part II#323.dst: Он сказал нам, где тебя найти.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#324.src: You seem to be getting close! You need to try again!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#324.dst: Кажется, ты уже близко! Попробуй ещё раз!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.src: Our best bet is to find somebody that may have seen what happened here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.dst: Лучше всего найти того, кто мог видеть, что тут произошло.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#325.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.src: Y'know I'm pretty good friends with the {p} Scouts.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#326.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#327.src: They are really observant of everything that goes on in and around the canyons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#327.dst: Они внимательно следят за всем, что творится в каньонах и вокруг.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#327.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.src: Meet me outside the {p} {p}, speak with me if you'd like to travel there together.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.dst: Встретимся у {p} {p}. Поговори со мной, если хочешь отправиться туда вместе.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#328.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.src: Meet up with Olon outside the {p} in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#329.dst: Встреться с Olon у {p} в {p}, в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.src: Let's go then! Glad you want to travel with me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.dst: Тогда в путь! Рад, что ты идёшь со мной.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#330.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.src: Here we are! The capital of Gavel, home of a lot of things I'm sure.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.dst: Вот и пришли! Столица Gavel, где, наверное, есть всё на свете.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#331.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.src: Alright- so we have to come up with a plan on what to do next, I have a few suggestions myself.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.dst: Так, нам нужно придумать план дальнейших действий. У меня есть пара идей.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#332.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.src: I've done some work for the {p} staff in the past and happen to know a few of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.dst: Я когда-то работал на служащих {p} и кое-кого из них знаю.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#333.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.src: We are actually quite good friends, what do you think?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.dst: Мы вообще-то неплохие друзья. Что скажешь?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#334.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#335.src: Sounds like a good plan to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#335.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.src: Head inside and look for someone who doesn't seem busy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.dst: Зайди внутрь и найди кого-нибудь, кто не занят.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#336.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.src: So you want us to sneak in?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.dst: Так ты хочешь, чтобы мы прокрались?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#337.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.src: Do you even know where we need to go?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.dst: Ты хоть знаешь, куда нам идти?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#338.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.src: Thought so... good thing I'm here then!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.dst: Так и думал… хорошо, что я здесь!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#339.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.src: As I previously mentioned, I've been helping out with keeping the gardens inside tidy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.dst: Как я уже говорил, я помогал ухаживать за садами внутри.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#340.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.src: I've picked up a few things here and there, obviously! The conclusion I have is...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.dst: Разумеется, я кое-что там разузнал! И вот мой вывод…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#341.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.src: There's a room at the top of the guild hall that stores old military documents.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.dst: На верху зала гильдии есть комната со старыми военными документами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#342.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.src: It isn't really in use anymore, meaning the way up won't be easy... meet me under the bridge.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.dst: Ею почти не пользуются, так что подняться будет непросто… встретимся под мостом.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#343.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#344.src: Find Olon's friend inside the {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.src: I haven't seen you in so long! I'm doing good, family too!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.dst: Сто лет тебя не видел! У меня всё хорошо, у семьи тоже!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#347.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.src: Glad to hear! Listen- we're quite busy today, do you know where the old military documents are being kept?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.dst: Рад слышать! Слушай, мы сегодня заняты - не знаешь, где хранят старые военные документы?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#348.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.src: Is this about the theory you had going? Actually- I recently did some work there.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.dst: Это про твою теорию? Кстати, я недавно там работал.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#349.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.src: There's an elevator up the stairs next to me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.dst: Рядом со мной, вверх по лестнице, есть лифт.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#350.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.src: Please come back and talk later! I miss our conversations.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.dst: Заходи потом поболтать! Скучаю по нашим беседам.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#351.speaker: Harvy

Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.src: Perfect! lets take that elevator up stairs right away.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.dst: Отлично! Поднимемся на этом лифте прямо сейчас.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#352.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#353.src: Meet Olon under the bridge at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#353.dst: Встреться с Olon под мостом в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#354.src: The archive should be at the top of one of the big towers of the {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#354.dst: Архив должен быть на вершине одной из больших башен {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#354.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#355.src: I had a brilliant idea of blessing you with some of my magic that you can hopefully use to get in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#355.dst: Мне пришла блестящая идея - наделить тебя частью моей магии, чтобы пробраться внутрь.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#355.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.src: I want to go meet up with my old friend, I'll hopefully see you soon.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.dst: Хочу повидаться со старым другом. Надеюсь, скоро увидимся.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#356.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.src: Do you see the pool of white magic next to us?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#357.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.src: Just hop in when you are ready to start.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#358.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.src: Use the pool of magic at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] to start heading towards the archive.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#361.dst: Воспользуйся лужей магии в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}], чтобы отправиться к архиву.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.src: Return to {p} Town by either using the Juggler merchant at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] or walking to [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part II#365.dst: Вернись в город {p}: через торговца-жонглёра в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] или пешком до [-{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.src: You found it? Great, it's just as I thought.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.dst: Есть находка? Здорово, всё как я и думал.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#366.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.src: Alright- this is the plan. I will stay behind and look for a map of the place mentioned, they almost always mark the reports properly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.dst: Так, план такой. Я останусь и поищу карту упомянутого места - они почти всегда отмечают отчёты как надо.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#367.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#368.src: Meet me in {p} Town, at the eastern town exit. Let's try to avoid the elders for now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#368.dst: Встретимся в городе {p}, у восточного выхода. Пока лучше избегать старейшин.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#368.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#369.src: If you want to get back to {p} Town I heard that there's a so called "juggler" merchant in {p} that will bring you there for free.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#369.dst: Если хочешь вернуться в город {p}, говорят, в {p} есть так называемый торговец-«жонглёр», который отвезёт тебя бесплатно.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#369.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.src: You could always walk too, I suppose.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#370.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#373.src: This road leads to the {p}, so we may have to look around for a while.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#373.dst: Эта дорога ведёт в {p}, так что искать, возможно, придётся долго.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#373.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.src: The canyon moves on its own. Alright, let's get going.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.dst: Каньон движется сам по себе. Ладно, в путь.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#374.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.src: I'm not here to stop you. Actually, I wanted to help out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.dst: Я не собираюсь вас останавливать. Наоборот, я хочу помочь.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#377.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.src: There are a lot of things wrong with this town, this society. The judgements that we've made...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.dst: В этом городе, в этом обществе многое неправильно. Решения, что мы принимали…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#378.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.src: Us elves aren't perfect. We like to say that- and frankly, many of us believe it too.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.dst: Мы, эльфы, не идеальны. Хоть и любим твердить обратное - и многие искренне в это верят.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#379.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#380.src: I've always wanted to be the change in {p} but it's troublesome to convince those who are stuck in their crooked ways.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#380.dst: Я всегда хотел изменить {p}, но убеждать тех, кто закоснел в своих кривых путях, тяжело.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#380.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#381.src: Please, bring back Elder Birch- for me. Follow the mountain road to the right until you come across a cave with mushrooms.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#381.dst: Прошу, верните Старейшину Birch - ради меня. Идите по горной дороге направо, пока не увидите пещеру с грибами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#381.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.src: In the meantime, I have some things to ask the Elders- good luck, both of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.dst: А я пока кое-что спрошу у старейшин. Удачи вам обоим.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#382.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#383.src: Find your way through the canyon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#385.src: You have one minute to explain what you're doing here and who you are before I collapse the mountains around you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#385.dst: У вас минута, чтобы объяснить, кто вы и что здесь делаете, пока горы вокруг вас не рухнули.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#385.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.src: An elf and a human- inside of my home!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.dst: Эльф и человек - в моём доме!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#386.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.src: You can tell THEM I haven't left my home since my banishment. I haven't said a word, nor have I even considered doing anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.dst: Передайте ИМ: с изгнания я сижу дома. Я молчу и даже не помышляю ни о чём таком.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#388.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.src: We aren't with the Elders. I'm from {p}! We are here for the truth.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.dst: Мы не со старейшинами. Я из {p}! Мы здесь ради правды.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#389.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.src: So this is a test, huh?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#390.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.src: Do they... want... me back? Is this why you are here?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.dst: Они… хотят… вернуть меня? Вы за этим пришли?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#392.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.src: We aren't connected to the Elders in any way! I'm here for personal reasons.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.dst: Мы никак не связаны со старейшинами! У меня личные причины.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#393.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.src: This is some sort of test from the Elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#396.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.src: Prove it! I can't believe they would just forget about me so quickly.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.dst: Докажите! Не верю, что они так быстро обо мне забыли.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#399.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.src: So what? That doesn't prove anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.dst: И что? Это ничего не доказывает.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#401.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.src: What... what did he say about me?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.dst: Что… что он сказал обо мне?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#403.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.src: He couldn't say much with th
Aldorei's Secret Part II#404.dst: При остальных он мало что мог сказать.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#406.src: Of course he did, he has always taken my side.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#406.dst: Конечно, он всегда был на моей стороне.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#406.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.src: You know what- I will come with you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.dst: Знаете что - я пойду с вами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#407.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.src: But I won't tell you anything. I'm only coming because of Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.dst: Но ничего не скажу. Я иду только ради Alder.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#408.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#409.src: He said he misses you and wa
Aldorei's Secret Part II#409.dst: Он сказал, что скучает и хочет, чтобы ты вернулся.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.src: Alder would never say that... especially not to the likes of you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.dst: Alder никогда бы так не сказал… тем более таким, как вы.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#410.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#411.src: Although- I do miss him dearly...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#411.dst: Хотя… я очень по нему скучаю…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#411.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#413.src: Tough luck- I don't know how that would convince me you're not with the elders.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#413.dst: Не выйдет - не вижу, как это докажет, что вы не от старейшин.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#413.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#414.src: You'll have to try harder than that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#414.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.src: If the Elders sent you, then you should already know the answer.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.dst: Если вас прислали старейшины, ответ вы и так знаете.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#415.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#416.src: I am not telling you anything...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#416.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.src: Where did that accusation come from?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#418.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.src: Are you two a bit slow or what? We are not killing anyone!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.dst: Вы что, туго соображаете? Мы никого не убиваем!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#419.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.src: If anything, the {p} elves brought it upon themselves by leaving our city.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.dst: Уж скорее эльфы {p} сами навлекли это на себя, уйдя из нашего города.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#420.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#422.src: Let's just say the town is magical. That's all you need to know.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#422.dst: Скажем так: город волшебный. Больше вам знать не нужно.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#422.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.src: Really... it seems I can't escape the past.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.dst: Надо же… похоже, от прошлого не убежать.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#424.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.src: I don't know what it is... but I want you to tell me more...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.dst: Не знаю, в чём дело… но я хочу услышать больше…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#425.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.src: Maybe it's time- time to confront the elders again. We must go.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.dst: Может, пора - пора снова встретиться со старейшинами. Нам нужно идти.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#426.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.src: Of course things happened- things happen everywhere!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.dst: Конечно, всякое бывало - всякое бывает везде!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#429.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.src: Elves are magical, that's why the city is magical.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.dst: Эльфы волшебны, потому и город волшебный.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#430.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#431.src: I'm not going to tell you anything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#431.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#433.src: {p} doesn't care about {p} elves, why would they kill them?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#433.dst: {p} нет дела до эльфов {p}, зачем их убивать?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#433.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.src: We have come very close to u
Aldorei's Secret Part II#434.dst: Мы уже почти раскрыли ваш секрет.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.src: Well, why are you here then?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#435.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.src: If you are so close, what do you need me for?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.dst: Раз вы так близки к разгадке, зачем вам я?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#436.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#438.src: Even though I have been banished, I would never want something like that.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#438.dst: Пусть меня изгнали, но такого я не желаю никому.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#438.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#442.src: Go on ahead. This is not something I expected to happen...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#442.dst: Идите. Кто бы мог подумать, что так выйдет…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#442.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.src: Return to the Elders with Elder Birch at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Aldorei's Secret Part II#443.dst: Вернись к старейшинам вместе со Старейшиной Birch в [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.src: You've got guts coming back here after everyth-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.dst: Хватило же наглости вернуться после все…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#445.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.src: Actually- we have someone that you might be interested in meeting.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.dst: Вообще-то у нас тут кое-кто, с кем вы, может, захотите встретиться.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#446.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#447.src: What is the meaning of this?!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#447.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#449.src: It's been so long, I didn't think you would come back.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#449.dst: Столько времени прошло. Я не думал, что ты вернёшься.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#449.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.src: Alder- I am sorry but the only reason I have returned is to set things right once and for all.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.dst: Alder, прости, но вернуться меня заставило одно: раз и навсегда всё исправить.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#450.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.src: These two individuals have the right to know what's going on.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.dst: Эти двое имеют право знать, что происходит.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#451.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#452.src: Are you out of your MIND! We voted on this all those years ago!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#452.dst: Ты В СВОЁМ УМЕ?! Мы голосовали за это много лет назад!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#452.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.src: If you tell them ANYTHING about the tree I will make sure your eternal life ends right here and now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.dst: Скажешь им ХОТЬ СЛОВО о дереве - и твоя вечная жизнь оборвётся здесь и сейчас.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#453.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.src: Oak- that is ENOUGH! Can't you see- this human is fighting the war we begun!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.dst: Oak, ХВАТИТ! Не видишь? Этот человек ведёт войну, начатую нами!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#454.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.src: They've earned it- they should know. Salvation of our light, our redemption!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.dst: Они это заслужили - пусть знают. Спасение нашего Света, наше искупление!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#455.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#456.src: I agree with Elder Birch, sir.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#456.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.src: {u}, Olon- the war you are fighting...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#458.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.src: We- we are the ones to blame. Our kind, our people...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.dst: Это мы… виноваты мы. Наш род, наш народ…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#459.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.src: The elves are the reason the world is in calamity. All because of one, senseless, selfish mistake.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.dst: Эльфы - причина бедствий мира. И всё из-за одной бессмысленной, эгоистичной ошибки.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#460.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.src: The worst fate that this world has seen, a fate beyond comprehension.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.dst: Худшая участь, что видел этот мир, участь за гранью понимания.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#461.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.src: Your leading question, about our immortality. The answer is simple- but there is more to it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.dst: Ваш главный вопрос - о нашем бессмертии. Ответ прост, но за ним кроется большее.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#462.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.src: We... we revealed the first gate- giving way for the darkness...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.dst: Мы… мы открыли первые врата - дав дорогу тьме…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#463.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#465.src: I'd rather if we show you. Meet me under the Cherry Blossom tree.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#465.dst: Лучше мы покажем. Встретимся под цветущей вишней.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#465.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#466.src: I- I will join you as well.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#466.dst: Я… я тоже пойду с вами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#466.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#467.src: Head down to the Cherry Blossom tree at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.src: This place- here is where it all began.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.dst: Это место… здесь всё и началось.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#468.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.src: The center of the Elven society, under the tree that protects our civilization.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.dst: Сердце эльфийского общества, под деревом, что хранит нашу цивилизацию.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#469.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.src: And, brings upon us our immortality...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#470.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.src: The roots expand deep inside this cavern that we've used for storage over the years.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.dst: Корни уходят глубоко в эту пещеру, которую мы годами использовали как хранилище.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#471.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#472.src: At least two Elders are required to open the passage. We will open the way for you two now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#472.dst: Чтобы открыть проход, нужны минимум двое старейшин. Сейчас мы откроем путь вам двоим.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#472.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.src: Be careful, nobody was meant to return there so certain defense mechanisms were put in place.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.dst: Осторожнее: никто не должен был туда возвращаться, поэтому там установлены защитные механизмы.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#473.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.src: Also, the information you will learn can harm all elves, unfortunately some things must be kept a secret.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.dst: И ещё: то, что вы узнаете, может навредить всем эльфам. Увы, некоторые вещи должны оставаться тайной.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#474.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.src: I've had a very bad feeling that we won't like what we see...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.dst: У меня дурное предчувствие, что увиденное нам не понравится…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#479.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.src: Well... It's too late to back down now.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#480.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.src: Do you feel the magical energy, it's almost like I can touch it.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.dst: Чувствуешь магическую энергию? Её будто можно потрогать.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#481.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.src: Is the water filled with logs?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#482.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#483.src: Have you noticed this... plant in the middle.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#483.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#484.src: It seems like this place is so alive, I mean just look at all of this coming from the logs!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#484.dst: Здесь всё будто полно жизни - ты только глянь, сколько всего растёт из брёвен!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#484.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#485.src: If you are here to stop us, we won't hesitate to hurt you!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#485.dst: Если вы пришли нас остановить, мы не колеблясь дадим отпор!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#485.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#486.src: On the contrary. I... realize, that this is something we can no longer keep quiet about.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#486.dst: Напротив. Я… понял, что об этом больше нельзя молчать.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#486.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.src: When you brought back Birch... it brought back memories, and I must admit. It made me realize I had lost myself along the way.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.dst: Когда вы вернули Birch… вернулись и воспоминания, и должен признать: я понял, что по пути потерял себя.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#487.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.src: We were ashamed of our actions- all of us. Scared for our people. If they knew the truth... there would be riots, wars, innocents would die!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.dst: Мы стыдились своих поступков - все мы. Боялись за свой народ. Узнай он правду… начались бы бунты, войны, гибли бы невинные!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#488.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#489.src: But because we locked up {p} from the outside, we grew a... god complex, so to speak.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#489.dst: Но, закрыв {p} от внешнего мира, мы, так сказать… возомнили себя богами.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#489.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.src: We lost track of why we locked ourselves in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#490.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.src: You will find the answers to your questions once you lay grasp of the wood.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.dst: Вы найдёте ответы на свои вопросы, как только коснётесь древесины.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#491.speaker: Elder Alder

Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.src: I assume you two already noticed the intense magical energy coming from here.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.dst: Полагаю, вы оба уже заметили мощную магическую энергию отсюда.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#492.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.src: This is the source of our immortality.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#493.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.src: The remnants of the original Guardian of the Forest.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#494.speaker: Elder Birch

Aldorei's Secret Part II#496.dst: Войди в бревно вместе с Olon.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.src: I have summoned you two for an important meeting.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.dst: Я созвал вас двоих на важное собрание.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#497.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#499.src: What did you see this time?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#499.dst: Что ты увидел на этот раз?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#499.speaker: Elder Elm

Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.src: It was unclear... The only thing I'm certain of is that he contacted me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.dst: Всё смутно… Точно знаю одно: Он связался со мной.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#500.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#501.src: I think... I think he wants us to witness him. This is finally our chance to grasp the light.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#501.dst: Думаю… думаю, Он хочет, чтобы мы узрели Его. Наконец-то наш шанс постичь Свет.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#501.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#502.src: And I know how we do that!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#502.dst: И я знаю, как это сделать!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#502.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.src: You must have realized by now that he is a direct contact to the other side. I think... I think it's time.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.dst: Вы уже должны были понять, что он - прямая связь с той стороной. Думаю… думаю, время пришло.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#505.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#507.src: ... cutting down the Guardian of the Forest!?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#507.speaker: Elder Elm

Aldorei's Secret Part II#509.src: Believe me- I hear how ludicrous this all sounds.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#509.dst: Поверьте, я понимаю, как нелепо это звучит.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#509.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.src: But think, why would I have visions of witnessing him moments after visions of the Guardian?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.dst: Но подумайте: почему сразу после видений о Хранителе мне явились видения, где мы узрим Его?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#510.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.src: We would be the first of our kind to witness him before death!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.dst: Мы станем первыми из нашего народа, кто узрит Его при жизни!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#511.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#512.src: I believe that's what he wants!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#512.dst: Я верю, что этого Он и хочет!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#512.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#514.src: Today is the day we meet our God!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#514.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#515.src: We will take down the Guardian of the Forest to open a gateway!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#515.dst: Мы повалим Хранителя леса, чтобы открыть врата!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#515.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.src: Today we establish history and a new chapter for all elves!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.dst: Сегодня мы творим историю и новую главу для всех эльфов!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#516.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#520.src: We do not have the time. Move along, young one.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#520.dst: У нас нет времени. Ступай, дитя.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#520.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#521.src: Wait! I don't think... this is a good idea.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#521.dst: Постойте! Мне кажется… это плохая идея.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#521.speaker: Lari

Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.src: But... I really don't think you should go ahead and hurt the Gua-
Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.dst: Но… правда, не стоит вредить Хра…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#523.speaker: Lari

Aldorei's Secret Part II#524.src: As the Elders of this town we've already decided on this. You are welcome to join us for this moment, young elf.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#524.dst: Мы, старейшины города, уже всё решили. Можешь разделить с нами этот миг, юная эльфийка.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#524.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#525.src: But if you as much as try to stop us, you will be banished.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#525.dst: Но если хоть попытаешься помешать, тебя изгонят.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#525.speaker: Elder Prometheus

Aldorei's Secret Part II#532.src: Talk to the Elders about the vision.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#534.src: This secret can never leave {p}. If it does- people will riot and wars will break out.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#534.dst: Эта тайна никогда не должна покинуть {p}. Иначе будут бунты и начнутся войны.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#534.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#535.src: Elves who had nothing to do with their decision will die.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#535.dst: Погибнут эльфы, не причастные к тому решению.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#535.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#536.src: This is far greater than any of us.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#536.dst: Это куда важнее любого из нас.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#536.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#537.src: I understand you may have questions.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#537.dst: Понимаю, у вас могут быть вопросы.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#537.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#538.src: Elder Prometheus died of old age, almost everyone from that time is dead. He elected us six to keep the secret safe.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#538.dst: Старейшина Prometheus умер от старости, как почти все из той эпохи. Он избрал нас шестерых хранить тайну.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#538.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.src: Apparently the immortality hadn't set in just yet- magic takes time.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.dst: Видимо, бессмертие тогда ещё не вступило в силу - магии нужно время.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#539.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#540.src: I don't think he really understood the extent of what he had done. We slowly began connecting the dots.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#540.dst: Не думаю, что он осознал масштаб содеянного. Мы понемногу начали связывать всё воедино.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#540.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#541.src: Everything seemed to lead back to the portals opening- the war in Wynn and the attack on Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#541.dst: Всё указывало на открытие порталов - войну в Wynn и нападение на Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#541.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#542.src: The magical wood from the Guardian of the Forest must radiate magic that grants us our life.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#542.dst: Волшебная древесина Хранителя леса, должно быть, излучает магию, дарующую нам жизнь.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#542.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.src: This is why we locked up {p}, letting people live immortal lives would have dire consequences.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.dst: Вот почему мы закрыли {p}: бессмертие для всех имело бы ужасные последствия.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#543.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.src: We tried to at least make up for some of the damage we had done...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.dst: Мы пытались хоть отчасти искупить причинённый вред…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#544.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#545.src: The portal being opened here caused a chain reaction that opened every portal.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#545.dst: Открытый здесь портал вызвал цепную реакцию, открывшую все порталы.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#545.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.src: This is unfortunately what cursed the world and made it possible for the corruption to leak into Wynn and beings of darkness to breach Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.dst: Увы, именно это прокляло мир, позволив Скверне просочиться в Wynn, а созданиям тьмы - прорваться в Gavel.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#546.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.src: This used to be an open cave that we decided to hide the rest of the Guardian in.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.dst: Раньше это была открытая пещера, в которой мы решили спрятать остатки Хранителя.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#547.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.src: It seems like the immense magic transformed this place to look like this...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.dst: Похоже, огромная магия превратила это место в то, что вы видите…
Aldorei's Secret Part II#548.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.src: We can't put innocent lives at risk- don't you agree?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.dst: Мы не можем подвергать опасности невинных - согласны?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#550.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.src: We will make our leave, you can jump after us to return to {p} Town.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.dst: Мы уходим. Прыгайте следом, чтобы вернуться в город {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#552.speaker: Elder Oak

Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.src: I didn't even hear you come in. I was too sucked up in this interesting book "Live Life Love Life".
Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.dst: Я и не заметил твоего прихода. Слишком увлёкся занятной книгой «Live Life Love Life».
Aldorei's Secret Part II#555.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.src: I've been reading all day to get myself in a different head space.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.dst: Я весь день читаю, чтобы настроиться на другой лад.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#557.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#558.src: Ah, who am I kidding- this book SUCKS!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#558.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.src: Come back tomorrow, please. I have about five more books to get through.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.dst: Приходи завтра, пожалуйста. Мне ещё книг пять осилить.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#559.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#561.src: I got inspired from my journey through the world of motivational writing yesterday.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#561.dst: Вчерашнее путешествие в мир мотивационной литературы меня вдохновило.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#561.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.src: The best thing in the world is to help people around you, is that not right.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.dst: Лучшее на свете - помогать окружающим, разве нет?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#562.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#563.src: This way I'll keep myself busy while still being of assistance.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#563.dst: Так я займу себя и заодно буду полезен.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#563.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.src: Well, I'm doing better. Thank you for asking.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.dst: Ну, мне уже лучше. Спасибо за заботу.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#564.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#565.src: My shame is slowly turning into hatred for those old elders, maybe that's progress.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#565.dst: Мой стыд понемногу превращается в ненависть к тем старым старейшинам - может, это прогресс.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#565.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.src: Please come back tomorrow, I have a gift for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.dst: Приходи завтра, пожалуйста, у меня для тебя подарок.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#566.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.src: I know I couldn't have done anything, I just find it so stupid.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.dst: Знаю, что ничего не мог поделать, просто это так глупо.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#568.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.src: Stupid that the so called, "all mighty, selfless elves" did something like this.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.dst: Глупо, что «всемогущие, бескорыстные эльфы» сотворили такое.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#569.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.src: You are earlier than I expected.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#571.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.src: I was planning to cook you a nice meal to as a thank you for getting me through these past two days and for helping me earlier.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.dst: Я хотел приготовить тебе вкусный ужин в благодарность за поддержку в эти два дня и за помощь раньше.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#572.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.src: I decided to pick up a couple of new hobbies to get my mind working, cooking being one of them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.dst: Я решил завести пару новых хобби, чтобы занять голову, - готовка одно из них.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#573.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#574.src: You have truly done more than I ever could have imagined. I'm proud to call you my friend.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#574.dst: Твои дела превзошли всё, что я мог вообразить. Горжусь, что могу звать тебя другом.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#574.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#576.src: I may or may not have forgot a couple of ingredients for my stew!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#576.dst: Я, может быть, забыл пару ингредиентов для рагу!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#576.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#577.src: Can you go around the forest seeing if you can find [{~} Leafy Stalks] and [{~} Mycanoid Spores] please.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#577.dst: Можешь пройтись по лесу и найти [{~} листовых стеблей] и [{~} спор Mycanoid]?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#577.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#578.src: I think I'm finally getting over my guilt.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#578.dst: Кажется, я наконец справляюсь с чувством вины.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#578.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#579.src: I realized that I never really took time to grieve my parents' death and I guess I was so occupied finding an answer to my big conspiracy that {p} killed them.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#579.dst: Я понял, что так и не оплакал родителей - видимо, был слишком занят доказательством своей большой теории заговора, что их убил {p}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#579.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.src: Then finding out all that information... It just all came crashing down on me.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.dst: А потом, когда всё выяснилось… всё просто рухнуло на меня.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#580.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.src: I'm grateful that you've managed to pull me out of that dark space, {u}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.dst: Спасибо тебе: без тебя я бы из этой тьмы не выбрался, {u}.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#581.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.src: I stayed up all night working on this new project of mine.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.dst: Я всю ночь не спал, работая над новым проектом.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#584.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.src: I picked up the wonderful art of painting and decided to make something for you.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.dst: Я освоил чудесное искусство живописи и решил кое-что для тебя сделать.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#585.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#586.src: I've also gone the entire day feeling good, for once.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#586.dst: И впервые за долгое время весь день мне было хорошо.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#586.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.src: I feel like I'm back on track. So it's time for me to start stressing over another conspiracy.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.dst: Кажется, я вернулся в колею. Значит, пора начинать переживать из-за нового заговора.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#587.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.src: I'm actually on my way to the {p} library to do some light reading, hoping to stumble upon another mystery.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.dst: Я как раз иду в библиотеку {p} почитать что-нибудь лёгкое, в надежде наткнуться на новую тайну.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#588.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.src: I hope you are careful on wherever journey leads you. If you ever need me, just drop by.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.dst: Береги себя, куда бы ни завёл тебя путь. Если понадоблюсь - заходи.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#590.speaker: Olon

Aldorei's Secret Part II#591.src: I've heard of you and what happened in the Valley.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#591.dst: Я слышала о тебе и о том, что произошло в Долине.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#592.src: Perfect! {u}, let's take that elevator upstairs right away.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#592.dst: Отлично! {u}, давай немедленно поднимемся на том подъёмнике.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#593.src: Wait! I don't think.. this is a good idea.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#593.dst: Постойте! Мне кажется… это не лучшая мысль.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.src: You can come back to Mona later.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#594.dst: Ты можешь вернуться к Mona позже.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#598.src: Uhm. Actually I'm busy, I have a lot to do today.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#598.dst: Эм. На самом деле я занята, у меня сегодня много дел.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.src: Perhaps Mona didn't like your attitude.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#599.dst: Возможно, Mona не понравилось твоё поведение.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#601.src: Farewell, make sure to let everybody know that I'm the smartest!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#601.dst: Прощай, и не забудь всем рассказать, что я самый умный!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#602.src: In that case- I assume majority of elves were buried in the lesser ones.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#602.dst: В таком случае - полагаю, большинство эльфов похоронили в тех, что поменьше.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#604.src: The documents should be in here somewhere.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#605.src: You flip through various documents before you find something that seems of interest...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#605.dst: Ты перелистываешь разные документы, пока не находишь кое-что любопытное…

Aldorei's Secret Part II#606.src: - {~}:{~} {p} Elves returned with freshly picked flowers. Canyon is stable.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#606.dst: - {~1}:{~2} Эльфы {p} вернулись со свежесорванными цветами. В Canyon спокойно.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#607.src: - {~}:{~} Small piece of rubble fell near {p} Wall. Nothing to be concerned of.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#607.dst: - {~1}:{~2} У стены {p} упал небольшой обломок. Беспокоиться не о чем.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#608.src: - {~}:{~} Mysterious group of elves spotted heading into the canyon through the eastern exit.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#608.dst: - {~1}:{~2} Замечена загадочная группа эльфов, направлявшаяся в каньон через восточный выход.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#609.src: - {~}:{~} Spotted elves again. Seems like... the six elders?
Aldorei's Secret Part II#609.dst: - {~1}:{~2} Снова видел эльфов. Похоже на… шестерых старейшин?

Aldorei's Secret Part II#610.src: - {~}:{~} They just entered one cave system we previously deemed as a dangerous area.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#610.dst: - {~1}:{~2} Они только что вошли в систему пещер, которую мы ранее признали опасной.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#611.src: - {~}:{~} Only five elders returned. They left one behind. I will mark the spot with an orange flag for further investigation.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#611.dst: - {~1}:{~2} Вернулись только пятеро старейшин. Одного они оставили там. Отмечу это место оранжевым флагом для дальнейшего расследования.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#612.src: Olon talked about the eastern exit next to the bank.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#612.dst: Olon говорил о восточном выходе рядом с банком.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#613.src: Venture into the canyon of the lost and find the entrance to the sealed away Elder at [{~}, {~}, -{~}]
Aldorei's Secret Part II#613.dst: Отправься в каньон потерянных и найди вход к запечатанному Старейшине на [{~}, {~}, -{~}]

Aldorei's Secret Part II#614.src: A sound can be heard from the main path...
Aldorei's Secret Part II#614.dst: С главного пути доносится какой-то звук…

Aldorei's Secret Part II#615.src: You've already interacted with this crystal.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#615.dst: Ты уже взаимодействовал с этим кристаллом.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#617.src: Birch did not like that answer. You need to try again!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#617.dst: Birch не понравился этот ответ. Придётся попробовать снова!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#618.src: You seem to be getting nowhere. You might need to trace back!
Aldorei's Secret Part II#618.dst: Похоже, ты никуда не продвигаешься. Возможно, стоит вернуться назад!

Aldorei's Secret Part II#619.src: Alder was the only one who s

Aldorei's Secret Part II#621.src: The Elders ignored the young elf's worries and went ahead.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#621.dst: Старейшины не стали слушать опасения юного эльфа и сделали по-своему.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#622.src: The thought of reaching their god was stronger than any logic.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#622.dst: Мысль о том, чтобы дотянуться до своего бога, была сильнее всякого здравого смысла.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#623.src: It turned out that the visions the elder had weren't encouragement- but a warning.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#623.dst: Оказалось, что видения старейшины были не ободрением, а предупреждением.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#624.src: The portal revealed itself, but no one could approach its center.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#624.dst: Портал открылся, но никто не смог подойти к его середине.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#625.src: The elves were successful, but none of them could grasp the light.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#625.dst: Эльфы добились своего, но ни один из них не смог ухватить этот свет.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#626.src: Little did they realize, that this was the start of the end. The act that set off everything.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#626.dst: Они и не подозревали, что это было начало конца. Поступок, с которого началось всё.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#627.src: The opening of the Light Portal caused a chain reaction throughout the world.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#627.dst: Открытие Портала Света вызвало цепную реакцию по всему миру.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#628.src: The Realm of War Portal opened in Wynn.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#628.dst: В Wynn открылся Портал Царства Войны.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#629.src: The Realm of Darkness Portal was also opened.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#630.src: The portals that had lied dormant for so many years... this was the beginning of a new era.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#630.dst: Порталы, что столько лет лежали в покое… это было начало новой эпохи.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#631.src: An era of an endless war- all created because of a selfish wish.
Aldorei's Secret Part II#631.dst: Эпохи бесконечной войны - и всё это из-за одного корыстного желания.

Aldorei's Secret Part II#632.src: You make your way back to {p}...
